ApplyDragForce(Vector2, float, float)

Apply drag to the given velocity.

public static Vector2 ApplyDragForce(Vector2 vel, float dragCoefficient, float dt)

Parameters

vel Vector2

The velocity that is affected by the drag.

dragCoefficient float

The drag coefficient for calculating the drag force. Has to be positive. 1 / drag coefficient = seconds until stop. DC of 4 means object stops in 0.25s.

dt float

The delta time of the current frame.

Returns

Vector2
